title: A document can carry its own user interface customizations, such as keyboard shortcuts, menus and toolbars, which take…
description: This vulnerability involves documents that can carry user interface customizations such as keyboard shortcuts, menus, and toolbars that execute macros or scripts even when macro security settings disallow macros. A user interacting with these customizations in a crafted document could run code without any warning. Fixed versions treat these customizations like other macro content, only allowing them when macros are permitted.
